strings.cancelTransferBody: The other side will be told the transfer stopped.
strings.causeConnectionLost: The connection to the other device was cut.
strings.causeDiskFull: There is not enough free space on this device.
strings.causeFileChanged: A file changed while it was being sent. Send it again once it is saved.
strings.causeNoPermission: TotalDrop is not allowed to read or write a file or folder it needs.
strings.causeNoRoute: No way of reaching the other device worked, directly or through the relay.
strings.causeNotFound: A file or folder could not be found. It may have been moved or deleted.
strings.causeProtocol: The other device sent something this version does not understand. Updating TotalDrop on both devices may help.
strings.causeReadOnly: The folder is on a disk that cannot be written to.
strings.causeRelay: The relay server could not be reached or is not set up, or the two devices do not use the same one.
strings.causeTimedOut: The connection stopped responding. One of the devices may have lost its network or gone to sleep.
strings.desktopComment: Send files straight to another device, end-to-end encrypted
strings.draftTranslation: This translation is being reviewed. Help improve it on GitHub.
strings.errorBadServer: The server address is not valid. It must start with wss://.
strings.errorCancelled: The other side stopped the transfer.
strings.errorCodeExpired: Nobody used the code before it expired. Send again to get a new code.
strings.errorCodeNotInUse: That code is not in use: it was mistyped, has expired or was already used. Ask the sender for a new one.
strings.errorConnect: Could not connect to the other device. Check that both devices are online and try again.
strings.errorInvalidOffer: The offer broke a safety rule, so it was refused.
strings.errorPeerLeft: The other side left before the transfer finished.
strings.errorServer: Could not reach the TotalDrop server. Check your internet connection.
strings.errorStorage: A file could not be read or saved.
strings.errorTextDamaged: The text did not arrive intact, so it is not shown.
strings.errorWrongCode: The code did not match. It was mistyped, or someone tried to intercept the transfer. Nothing was sent. Start again with a new code.
strings.homeFooter: End-to-end encrypted. No account, no email, no phone number.
strings.homeReceiveBody: Enter a code and save the files
strings.homeSendBody: Pick files and share a short code
strings.keepAwakeReason: TotalDrop is sending or receiving files
strings.linkBusy: Finish or stop what is on the screen, then open the link again.
strings.metainfoAbout: TotalDrop sends files and folders from one device to another, end-to-end encrypted. Pick the files, share a short code or a QR code, and the other device receives them. No account, no email, no phone number.
strings.metainfoOnePackage: Use one Linux package at a time. The Flatpak and the .pkg, .deb or .rpm package share one name, so while one of them is open, starting the other brings the open window forward instead of opening a second one.
strings.metainfoSummary: Send files straight to another device
strings.metainfoTheme: Follows your desktop's theme: Plasma, Hyprland, Omarchy, GNOME
strings.metainfoVerified: Every file is verified on arrival; damaged files are discarded
strings.metainfoWords: Four verification words show that nobody is in the middle
strings.otherPackageFlatpak: TotalDrop is already open from the Flatpak, so that window was brought forward. Use one package at a time: quit that window to open this one.
strings.otherPackageSystem: TotalDrop is already open from the .pkg, .deb or .rpm package, so that window was brought forward. Use one package at a time: quit that window to open this one.
strings.pickImageTitle: Choose an image with a QR code
strings.privacyMode: Hide my address from the other device
strings.privacyModeConfirmBody: Transfers will be slower, because nothing goes directly between the devices. The rendezvous server and the relay still see your IP address; they never see your files or keys.
strings.privacyModeHint: Privacy mode: everything goes through the relay, so the other device never learns your IP address. Slower, and the other device must use the same relay (the default one does).
strings.receiveCodeHelp: Ask the sender for their code.
strings.receiveCodeInvalid: That does not look like a code. It starts with a number, then two or three words.
strings.receiveOfferTextNote: The text is shown here, not saved.
strings.receiveQrNotFound: There is no TotalDrop code in that image.
strings.receiveTextHidden: The text holds hidden characters, shown as U+…. Copying gives the text exactly as it came.
strings.receiveTextShortened: Only the beginning of the text is shown. Copy text copies all of it.
strings.sameNetworkNote: Works across the internet. When the devices cannot reach each other directly, the encrypted transfer goes through the relay, which cannot read it.
strings.sendAddFailed: The files could not be added. Try again. If it happens again, check that this device has enough free space, or choose the files from another place.
strings.sendClipboardKept: The text already typed is kept; the clipboard was not used.
strings.sendCodeHint: On the other device, open TotalDrop, tap Receive and enter this code.
strings.sendDoneBody: {count, plural, =1{The file arrived intact.} other{All {count} files arrived intact.}}
strings.sendDropHint: You can also drag files onto this window.
strings.sendEmptyHint: Add the files you want to send. The receiver gets exactly these, nothing else.
strings.sendQrHint: Or scan this code with the other device's camera.
strings.sendShareText: Get my files with TotalDrop. Code: {code}
strings.sendSomeFailed: {count, plural, =1{One file did not arrive intact and was discarded.} other{{count} files did not arrive intact and were discarded.}}
strings.sendStrongCodeHint: Three words instead of two: much harder to guess
strings.sendTextHidden: The text holds hidden characters, such as direction marks. They are sent with it.
strings.sendTextHint: Type or paste the text to send
strings.sendTextShortened: Only the beginning of the text is shown; all of it is sent.
strings.sendTextTooLong: A text can be at most {size}. Send a longer one as a file.
strings.sendWaitingAccept: Check the words, then wait for the receiver to accept.
strings.settingsAboutBody: TotalDrop is free and open source, funded by donations. Licensed GPL-3.0-or-later.
strings.settingsPrivacyBody: The rendezvous server, the relay and Cloudflare's STUN server see your IP address, and so does the other device when you connect directly (unless privacy mode is on). None of them sees file names, contents or keys, and our servers keep no logs. Files go directly between the devices when they can, otherwise through the relay; they are encrypted end to end either way.
strings.settingsServerHelp: Helps two devices with the same code find each other. It never sees your files or keys.
strings.settingsWordsEnglish: Codes and verification words are in English in every language, so two devices set to different languages show the same words.
strings.setupBackgroundAllowed: Android's battery optimisation is off for TotalDrop.
strings.setupBackgroundBatteryHint: On TotalDrop's app info page, open Battery and allow unrestricted use. The names of these settings differ from phone to phone.
strings.setupBackgroundBody: So that a transfer keeps going when you switch apps or lock the screen, let TotalDrop run without battery restrictions. TotalDrop works in the background only while a transfer you started is running.
strings.setupBackgroundMaker: {maker} phones have a battery saver of their own
strings.setupBackgroundMakerBody: Open TotalDrop's battery saver too and choose "No restrictions". If the phone has Autostart, turn it on for TotalDrop.
strings.setupBackgroundRestricted: Android's battery optimisation is on for TotalDrop: a transfer may stop when you switch apps.
strings.setupBackgroundTitle: Keep transfers going in the background
strings.shareBusy: A transfer is still running. Wait for it to finish or stop it, then share again.
strings.shareSkipped: {count, plural, =1{One shared item could not be read and was left out.} other{{count} shared items could not be read and were left out.}}
strings.technicalDetail: Technical message in English, to include when you report a problem:
strings.transferNoticeBody: Keeps going while you use other apps.
strings.verificationHint: The other person sees the same four words. If they differ, stop.
